title: Arts and Design Skeleton v1
description: Coverage skeleton for the arts-and-design continent (eighth continent, parallel round v1 strand 13d, merge order 4 — vault parallel-round-v1.md, CPO co-agreed 2026-06-11): field/subfield two-level node set under domain:arts-and-design — music, visual arts, design, performing arts and architecture — each tagged with academic_status. Construction input only — not canonical graph data; nodes only, zero edges (skeleton-first). The junction node already canonical in /data (domain:arts-and-design, Q2018526 — session #11 seed-audit corrected anchor) is out of generation scope; subfield:aesthetics (Q35986) is philosophy-continent property and must not be re-proposed or modified. Architecture is owned by this batch per the parallel-round boundary assignment table (13c will not create it); its engineering-side second membership is a same-batch §13 task under separate live evidence.

include: Arts and design field and subfield coverage skeleton (nodes only)
Music areas under LCC class M (M scores / ML literature on music / MT instruction and study) and UDC 78, FORD 6.4 music
Visual-arts areas under LCC class N (N/NB/NC/ND/NE/NK/NX) and UDC 73-77
Design areas under LCC NC/NK and UDC 74 (drawing, design, applied arts and crafts)
Performing-arts areas under UDC 791-793.3 (cinema, theatre, dance), FORD 6.4 performing arts
Architecture under LCC NA and UDC 72 (classification home — art side primary)
Physical-planning wing under UDC 71 (landscape architecture, planning) subject to per-seed two-prong tests
Wikidata QID resolution for identity and external_ids
exclude: Edges and relations (skeleton-first: dots before lines; part_of skeleton edges are a separate batch)
Level-3 concepts, persons, works, movements, styles and periods (UDC 7.03x material)
Re-proposing any existing /data node (domain:arts-and-design and all 195 other canonical nodes; reconcile to existing IDs instead)
subfield:aesthetics (Q35986, philosophy continent): UDC 7.01 art-theory candidates must pass an identity-distinct test against it; the philosophy node itself is untouchable

Recreation, entertainment, games and sport (UDC 793.5-799, 796-799; LCC GV as home class): pre-registered scope-exclusion — community home is sports science / health; record as deliberate non-coverage, do not generate
Media and communication studies (FORD 5.8 — social-sciences continent, strand 13a; film studies stays in-continent via its UDC 791 classification home)
Literature, linguistics and other LCC class-P disciplines (humanities-residual continent; theatre/film PN ranges are other-home filings, not an invitation to model literature)
Music therapy (ML3919-3920 — medicine adjacency), arts administration/patronage (NX700-770 — below skeleton granularity)

allowed_public_sources.notes: CC0. Resolver verifies the unverified training-knowledge QID hints in the proposal and fills missing QIDs.
External-link / source-resolution pointer only. Never store or cache article bodies.

forbidden_sources.reason: NamuWiki is external-link-only and must never be used as evidence or a source, nor have its content cached.
No cloud LLM API calls are permitted in repo tooling, build, validation, or runtime.
Scraping or crawling third-party article bodies is forbidden; only open, license-compatible data is allowed.

notes: Parallel round v1, strand 13d (vault parallel-round-v1.md — §12 snapshot pin = commit d816cb6; promotion merge order 4 with succession rule).

Coverage baseline for generation/QC: LCC class M outline (lcco_m.pdf — M/ML/MT) and class N outline (lcco_n.pdf — N/NA/NB/NC/ND/NE/NK/NX), UDC class 7 with children 71-79 (udcsummary.info getrecord), and OECD FORD section 6.4 (arrs.si mirror, live-verified this session; also carries the 2.1 civil-engineering record used by the architecture §13 task). No discipline-specific scheme is ratified for this continent — LCC M·N and UDC 7 are the gate schemes, FORD 6.4 the cross-check. All sources live-captured by the orchestrator on 2026-06-11 before this manifest was written (dist/foundry/captures/arts-design-skeleton-v1/).

docs/data-foundry.md section 12 (including its precedent log, at pin d816cb6) is a mandatory input to the generation order (promotion policy v1.3); section 13 governs any multi-membership question raised during QC.

Pre-registered structural questions for QC: (1) architecture dual membership — art side primary (LCC NA + UDC 72 captured), engineering side requires separately live-verified evidence (FORD 2.1 / LCC TH / UDC 69) and is written in the same batch only if its own gate is met (§13 anti-spam guard); (2) UDC 7.01 art-theory candidates take an identity-distinct test against subfield:aesthetics (philosophy node untouched, relations recorded only); (3) recreation/entertainment/sport wing (UDC 793.5-799, 796-799) is scope-excluded as deliberate non-coverage (community home sports science/health); (4) humanities-adjacent areas (musicology, art history) stay in-continent while their classification home is class M/N (humanities-residual continent not yet entered); (5) FORD 5.8 media-communications belongs to social sciences (13a) — film studies stays via UDC 791 classification home; (6) industrial design's engineering adjacency is a §13 candidate record only (13c boundary); (7) photography's LCC TR home and theatre/dance/film's PN/GV homes are other-home filings — class-G precedent interpretation applies when UDC 7 + FORD 6.4 + community file them in-continent; (8) UDC 71 planning wing takes strict per-seed two-prong tests (urban-planning record-only deferral acceptable); (9) decorative-arts overlap/absorption tests vs named design subfields (shared NK ranges).
/data remains the source of truth for accepted graph data.
